lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits. A primary horizontal row of ~7-8 large clusters occupies the mid-flank, bounded by secondary rows of smaller, lower-intensity clusters both dorsally and ventrally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical zones of elevated pixel intensity are discernible, aligning with the vertical columns of circular clusters to form a series of rectangular grid nodes across the mid-to-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient (high luminance on top, low luminance shadow below) extending from the gills toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 10-14 small, discrete high-luminance blobs, with a higher concentration localized along the leading edge and lower density toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin. A secondary V-shaped notch is present on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a high-frequency distribution of micro-scale high-luminance specks, distinct from the larger macro-blobs on the lateral flank.
